title: Where things are
summary: Say where people and things are with the locative `-dA`, say what there is and isn't with *bar* and *ýok*, put endings on names, and say here, there and what you have with you.
canDo: Say where you and other people are, and ask where someone is
Say what there is and isn't in a place, and ask about it
Write endings on names of people and places
Say what you have with you
